concerns.text: Task T107 ‘Fix VIF Calculation Logic’ lacks a concrete verification criterion. The comment ‘<!-- FAILED: unspecified -->’ indicates the verification is undefined, making the task unexecutable until a specific test (e.g., VIF value check against expected high multicollinearity threshold) is described.

Task T041c ‘Plotting Module’ verification mentions “contains required metadata” without specifying what metadata must be present. This vague requirement prevents deterministic implementation; the task should list the exact metadata fields (e.g., title, axes labels, legend, source citation) to be asserted.

Task T041a groups three model types (linear, polynomial, logarithmic) into a single task. While executable, the granularity is coarse for a task list; splitting into separate tasks per model would improve clarity and enable independent verification.
